QR residual diagnostics flag 33886 of 37182 point-sensor fits above 0.05; no WLS fallback fits or discarded resolved curvature. This is not evidence that all recovered Hessians are accurate.
Original native reference remains replicated. Rank-box exchange retains all 852 wall faces in this RAE2822 fixture; the separated-wall MPI unit fixture retains at most 9 of 18.
Quadratic recovery remains primal-only and limited to two rings; periodic and symmetry markers retain their existing configuration restrictions.
Forward scalar eigensolver derivative probe with a subnormal off-diagonal 1e-310 remains NaN before and after the primal fix. Full AD derivatives at this pre-existing extreme case are not fixed.
